sentence: This project studies the factors influencing how reliably electroosmotic pumps do mechanical work for haptic displays.
This project builds a sensing system that picks up weak electromagnetic signals given off by computer processors or memories.
This project brings together scholars and practitioners to work out how to protect biodiversity in cities as the climate changes.
This project develops flexible chiral light emitting materials using deep eutectic solvents and machine learning to predict solvent properties.
This project studies the structures and chemical bonding of boron and metal-boride nanoclusters using photoelectron spectroscopy and imaging.
This project applies machine learning to biomaterials datasets to predict drug and gene delivery performance and choose candidate monomers.
This project improves sensors made from laser-induced graphene by attaching biomolecules such as antibodies and DNA to the electrodes.
This project develops edible microcarriers made from whey protein that help cells grow for cultivated meat production.
This project studies how a motor protein called dynein is turned on to start moving cargo in the axon terminal of neurons.
This project studies how a classical user can test and describe complex quantum objects, including entanglement in untrusted quantum devices.
This project uses machine learning to speed up computer models of hot water flowing through rock while keeping the underlying physics intact.
This project builds an open-source community around an image analysis package used to measure and model plant properties.
This project builds a power testbed and a virtual lab to simulate cyberspace threats to energy systems and defend against them using machine learning.
This project compares two data assimilation methods to see which physical situations each one models well, including wildfire spread.
This project studies how the geometry and internal structure of metallic lattice materials let them move with expansive soils instead of resisting them.
This project builds a model of hippocampal spatial learning that links synaptic connections between neurons to learning, using algebraic topology.
This project develops a way to shape lightweight glass mirrors by using ultrafast lasers to create stress patterns inside the glass.
